reports.method: Real Nuked OPN2 generated JS factories/WASM through unchanged Ym2612, actual YM2612Synth/DirectTransport and GenesisAudioEngine/VgmPlayer with real SegaPSG. Exact Float32 stereo PCM, bus read/status/IRQ and hooks, partition invariance, selected reset/reprogram replay and probes. Independent multiplexed 9-bit DAC/ladder/DC/pan formula, bus-write timing, owned/borrowed/envelope-zero and interleaved-handle controls. No tolerance or mock.
limits: sampleRate(clock) only calculates floor(clock/144). Pitch-calculation clocks quantize frequency registers; no dynamic resampler or clock setting is claimed.

Nuked has the 12-function YM2612 C ABI without native save/load/mute. Shared JS optional state methods reject, reserve and borrowed generation are supported; no low-level Into API. Four envelope traces are intentionally zero. Synth getState is a JS register model.

Every bus-byte write advances 24 internal clocks, discarding one frame; register pairs advance 48. Generation sums 24 internal outputs, scales by 11, clips to signed 16-bit and divides by 32768. YM2612 ladder/DC idle and disabled-pan values are intentionally nonzero.

Core read(0) refreshes a status latch; non-status ports may return the latched value. Reads are included in the matched histories. Observations are after fixture events and chunks, not every hardware clock.
Reset clears the Nuked chip. Chip type is module-global and every create selects YM2612 mode; tested handles share that mode. No multi-type cohabitation claim.
VgmPlayer lacks native checkpoints with this backend; the actual engine/player exercise explicit reset/replay fallback, not a new seek API.
Synchronous Node/WASM only; browser, synthesis Worklet scheduling, Native/Tauri, physical output, listening judgment and hardware accuracy are outside scope.
reports.frameCountScope: Both builds: scenario bodies and 127-frame probes, selected reset replays, wrapper controls, real Synth and actual engine-generated player output including prefetched PCM (delivered frame count is recorded separately). One stereo frame is one left/right pair. Bus-write discarded outputs are not delivered PCM and are not counted.
